verdict.rationale: Aircall's own docs include a tutorial for moving recordings and voicemail into your own infrastructure (aircall-docs-8). Its Public API exposes retrieval endpoints for transcriptions, sentiments, topics and summaries, so some data can be pulled out programmatically. However, there is no documented 'export all data' feature, no statement of open formats, and no offboarding or account-exit path, so this rests on API/tutorial-based extraction of parts of the data. Missing for 10: documented full-account bulk export, explicit open formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/standard audio) covering calls, contacts, SMS and settings, offboarding guidance, and independent corroboration.
